standard_prerequisites.name: Representability of diagonals of spaces
standard_prerequisites.use: The absolute diagonal factors through the base diagonal.

standard_prerequisites.name: Finiteness implies properness

standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the image E of the complement closed.

core_obligations: Reduce the absolute diagonal to the relative one composed with a base change of Delta_Y.
Construct V for two pairs (a, Z_1), (a, Z_2) with common a: form E as the union of the pr_0-images of Z_i minus the intersection.
Check E closed via properness of the finite pr_0|_{Z_i}, and verify V = T minus E satisfies the factorization equivalence.
proof_roadmap: Construct the excluded closed set E and verify the universal factorization property of its complement.
difficulty_reason: The construction and verification of V are the substance of the diagonal statement.
